description: This file defines the CatalogContextSeed class responsible for seeding initial data into the catalog database context, including catalog brands, types, and items, with retry logic and database migration support.

classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: A helper class for seeding initial catalog data into the database asynchronously with retry logic.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Seeds the catalog database with initial data if the relevant tables are empty, with retry and error handling.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Returns a predefined list of catalog brands.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Returns a predefined list of catalog types.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined catalog items.
